source: ENISA Space Threat Landscape 2025, Annex C Table 17 (via Phalanx/framework/enisa_threats_tuple.csv)
name: Denial of Service (DoS)
description: DoS can pose a threat to both the satellite control center and TTC ground stations, as well as the bus and the payload of the space segment, affecting their availability. Given the common practice of segregation between the bus and the payload, in the case of the space segement, such threats would primarily need to be executed through the bus. DoS may be perpetrated through various kinds of techniques, such as flooding of satellite with requests/commands.
